name: Coda
description: Coda combines documents, spreadsheet-style tables, and app-like building blocks into a single collaborative surface for teams.
best_for: Positioned for cross-functional teams — product, sales, engineering, design, marketing, HR — as a single tool replacing separate docs, spreadsheets, and wikis.
features: Trackers and apps built on database-style tables
Coda AI for chat, generation, and automated columns

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: Unlimited unshared docs, basic table size limits, standard Packs, and collaborative viewing.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: Billed annually at $10/doc maker/mo (or $12/mo monthly); adds unlimited doc size, hidden pages, 30-day version history, and custom domains. Editors and viewers are free.

tiers.name: Team
tiers.notes: Billed annually at $30/doc maker/mo (or $36/mo monthly); adds unlimited version history, advanced Packs, automation rules, and team workspaces.

pros: Doc maker pricing model only charges for creators while viewers and editors collaborate for free
Powerful interactive formula language and button automations turn static docs into internal web applications
Deep two-way integrations (Packs) syncing live data from Jira, Slack, GitHub, and Google Calendar
cons: Steeper learning curve for formula and database logic compared to standard document editors
Mobile app experience is more limited than the full desktop web builder
Large complex docs with hundreds of automation rules can experience slower initial load times

alternatives.name: Notion
alternatives.description: A flexible workspace combining documents, databases, project boards, and team knowledge.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want a simpler, more visual all-in-one workspace

alternatives.name: ClickUp
alternatives.description: A project-management platform with tasks, dashboards, documents, and workflow automation.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that need more structured project tracking alongside docs

alternatives.name: Confluence
alternatives.description: A team knowledge-management platform designed for documentation and internal collaboration.
alternatives.best_for: Larger teams standardizing on structured documentation
